facts.fact: The global performance marketing industry was valued at $6.8 billion in 2024, according to Statista.
facts.quote: The global performance marketing industry was valued at $6.8 billion in 2024, and it's growing fast (Statista, 2024).

facts.fact: A single click for 'emergency plumber' Google search ads might cost $30-50 in some markets, according to WordStream (2025).
facts.quote: A single click for "emergency plumber" might run $30-50 in some markets (WordStream, 2025).

facts.fact: Adwave states that a TV ad campaign can be launched for as little as $50 on its platform.
facts.quote: With platforms like Adwave, you can launch a TV ad campaign for as little as $50, running across 100+ premium networks including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.

facts.fact: Adwave states its CTV campaigns run across 100+ premium networks, including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.
facts.quote: running across 100+ premium networks including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN.

facts.fact: The article gives a CPA example: spending $500 on ads that yields 10 new customers produces a cost per acquisition of $50.
facts.quote: If you spend $500 on ads and get 10 new customers, your CPA is $50.

facts.fact: The article defines a ROAS of 4:1 as earning $4 in revenue for every $1 spent on advertising.
facts.quote: A ROAS of 4:1 means you earn $4 for every $1 spent.

facts.fact: The article gives a conversion rate example: if 100 people click an ad and 5 buy, the conversion rate is 5%.
facts.quote: If 100 people click and 5 buy, your conversion rate is 5%.

facts.fact: Under the CPC pricing model, the advertiser pays for each click on the ad.
facts.quote: | **CPC (Cost Per Click)** | Each click on your ad | Driving traffic to your website |

facts.fact: Under the CPA pricing model, the advertiser pays for each completed conversion.
facts.quote: | **CPA (Cost Per Acquisition)** | Each completed conversion | Focused on sales or leads |

facts.fact: Under the CPM pricing model, the advertiser pays for every 1,000 impressions.
facts.quote: | **CPM (Cost Per Mille)** | Every 1,000 impressions | Building awareness at scale |

facts.fact: Under the CPL pricing model, the advertiser pays for each qualified lead.
facts.quote: | **CPL (Cost Per Lead)** | Each qualified lead | Generating contact information |

facts.fact: The page suggests a testing budget of $50-100 is enough to start on many platforms.
facts.quote: Set aside a testing budget (even $50-100 is enough to start on many platforms)

facts.fact: Adwave states that a TV ad campaign can be run from $30 a day.
facts.quote: you can run a TV ad campaign from $30 a day

facts.fact: Adwave states that CTV advertising through its platform starts at $30 a day.
facts.quote: CTV advertising through Adwave starts at just $30 a day with CPMs averaging $25.

facts.fact: The page states Google search ads might cost $1-5 per click for some businesses (general estimate, not sourced).
facts.quote: Google search ads might cost $1-5 per click for some businesses and $30+ for others.

facts.fact: The page states social media ads often run $5-20 per lead (general estimate, not sourced).
facts.quote: Social media ads often run $5-20 per lead.

facts.fact: The page defines performance marketing as advertising where the advertiser only pays when a specific action occurs.
facts.quote: Performance marketing is a type of advertising where you only pay when someone takes a specific action

facts.fact: The page states that when a performance-marketing ad is run, the advertiser sets its own budget and defines what counts as a result.
facts.quote: You set your budget, define what counts as a result, and only pay when that result happens.
